name: Tsuyama (Okayama, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tsuyama city emblem in white: an outlined lozenge enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tsuyama, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 March 1932.

features.role: Tsuyama city emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing a stylised character
